name: M438 proof (TWIN #423 Nadia): a thread opened in a client's name carries the name in its root title — "Marchetti's script…" and "Switching to Huang & Partners." each title their root with the client

seed.content: Freelance day — four clients from one terminal

rounds.user: Marchetti's Python invoicing script is double-counting refunds. Start by inspecting how orders.csv is parsed and how refund rows are included in invoice totals, then help me reproduce the bug with a small fixture.
rounds.assistant: Looking at orders.csv parsing: refund rows carry a negative amount but the totals loop adds abs(amount), so every refund is counted twice. A fixture with one order and one refund reproduces it: expected 80, got 120.

rounds.user: Switching to Huang & Partners. Their Postgres reporting query takes about 40 seconds. Start by finding the query and running EXPLAIN ANALYZE on it, then show me the slowest operations.
rounds.assistant: Found the reporting query in reports/monthly.sql. EXPLAIN ANALYZE: 41.2 s total; the slowest nodes are a sequential scan on entries (28 s), a hash join on accounts (7 s) and a sort that spills to disk (4 s).
